Comments.Comment: Using the Signal Follower for ducking & gate FX
Start the phrase, then use the macros to adjust the ducking/gate amount...
Head into the Effects tab, and you will see three effect-chains:

'Kick' is the source of the gate/duck, its amplitude being tracked by a Signal Follower. This value is then passed on to a Hydra device. From the Hydra, the signal is distributed to gainer device in the Sine/Duck chains, respectively.
